summary: Executed backend pytest smoke checks and frontend Playwright validation for customer/operator auth, lobby accessibility, Three.js lazy-loading, and poker operator controls.

integration_issues.issue: Browser console showed warning 'theme load failed TypeError: Failed to fetch' on first /asiakas load in one run; app still functioned and login succeeded.

action_items: Investigate intermittent /api/theme fetch warning on customer page load (console warning, non-blocking).
Optional: expose poker status for easier deterministic UI assertion from browser globals if future tests depend on it.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical regressions found in referenced files for requested scope.
Lazy-loading path is correctly scoped via dynamic import in customer template and resource timing validated during run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated: customer/operator login, 7 accessible lobby tiles, Three.js/casino_3d not loaded pre-Blackjack and loaded post-open, blackjack canvas rendered, operator poker join URL uses /asiakas, preset armed badge visible when presets exist, and Set next hand visible when waiting after voiding active hand.
rca of the issue: Potential transient network/backend route hiccup for /api/theme on initial customer page boot triggered a console warning once; did not reproduce as a blocking failure in subsequent operator-focused run.
